questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Schistosoma japonicum?
options: Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Embryonated eggs in stool; tissue eggs may also be demonstrated.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Embryonated eggs in stool; tissue eggs may also be demonstrated. Stool concentration or quantitative egg microscopy at 100–400×; low-intensity infection may need additional validated tests.
